Keep models honest as data carriers

Model diagnostics prevent behaviour, manufactured defaults and framework-bound validation from accumulating in transported state. Business-operation validation stays in services where creation, update and deletion can apply different policies.

The value of enforcing this family

Models remain predictable to serialize, compare and move between layers.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
